company.description:
Turing is a research and development digital platform that improves speed-to-market for consumer goods. It is built to overcome major challenges shared by the world’s biggest consumer goods companies. It aims to bring the latest technologies and newer approaches to product development, product innovation, or renovation.

It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in New York, United States.

aiResearchSummary.text: Turing Labs is engaged in developing systems and methods for accelerating product formulation design, as described in titles such as 'Systems and methods for diversity-enhanced adaptive experimentation' and 'Systems and methods for generating an extensible digital formulation network.' Their work involves adaptive generation of experimental product formulations, leveraging machine learning models, and integrating expert knowledge to optimize and expedite the creation of consumer goods formulations.
